title: [LOGGED OUT] Mobile "Add It to Home Screen" banner text has no spelling mistake
reason: Banner second line reads "To got a quicker access !" (grammar error). Mobile via Chrome mobileEmulation fallback (390x844, DPR 3, iPhone UA), not emulate_device.

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser on a phone screen (iPhone 14 size, 390x844) and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home page loaded at 390px wide; cookie banner and "Add It to Home Screen" banner visible.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Cookie banner shown; clicked Dismiss, banner closed.

steps.text: Does the second line of the "Add It to Home Screen" banner read correct English (for example "To get quicker access!") rather than "To got a quicker access !"?
steps.saw: Second line text in the DOM is exactly "To got a quicker access !" (wrong verb "got", extra article "a", space before "!").

steps.text: Click the X (close) button of the banner. Do not click "Claim".
steps.saw: Clicked the X ("Close pwa banner"); banner closed. Claim not clicked.
